name: Chat channel
summary: A named room for live text chat: everyone in the room sees each message at once, in time order.
how: Name the room with a # at the start.
Show the messages in time order, the newest at the bottom.
List the people who are in the room.

origin.note: Jarkko Oikarinen writes Internet Relay Chat, with rooms called channels that start with #.

adoptions.via: Discord puts # text channels and voice channels in a server for each community.
